subject: Post-call recap: governance matrix + proposed milestones
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <lpark@vivantlabs.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@vivantlabs.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: governance matrix + proposed milestones

Thanks again for your time today — quick recap and proposed governance matrix so we can lock dates and owners. I captured what felt most important; please correct anything I missed.

Key pain points we heard
- Cost unpredictability for peak inference during end-of-month batch processing (20–30% over budget)
- Latency variability impacting agent workflows (95th pct spikes above 800ms)
- Auditability: need fine-grained request logs and retention controls for PHI pipeline

Outcome & success criteria
- 20% reduction in per-token cost in steady-state; peak guardrails for batch windows
- 95th pct latency under 400ms for 8k token workloads in prod SLA window
- SOC2 evidence + audit-ready logs for initial pilot scope

Proposed milestones (first pass)
1) Pilot kickoff & access (customer test env + Redwood sandbox) — target: 2027-05-06 — owner: Vivant infra (Lydia) / Redwood (SoJin)
2) Performance baseline & config run (batching/quantization) — target: 2027-05-20 — owner: Redwood (Eng/Pre-sales)
3) Security & compliance handoff (SOC2 artifacts + log retention) — target: 2027-05-27 — owner: Vivant procurement (Tom) / Redwood Security
4) Executive review & go/no-go to reserved capacity — target: 2027-06-03 — owner: Vivant exec / Redwood AE

Governance matrix (who to loop)
- Business sponsor: Rajiv Menon (Vivant VP Data) — exec decisions
- Procurement: Tom Reynolds — contract, procurement, onboarding steps
- Technical lead: Lydia Park — infra, test access, acceptance criteria
- Redwood AE: Soojin Lee — commercial, rollout plans
- Redwood Solutions: Marissa Cole — pilot scoping and pre-sales tasks

I've attached a one-tab MPA (Vivant_MPA_v1.xlsx) with the above as a starting template. Please reply with: (A) any edits to milestones/owners/dates; (B) procurement contact for contract/legal (if different from Tom); (C) whether you want a short NDA-first path or straight-to-pilot.

Thanks — I can jump on a quick 20-min sync tomorrow if that helps finalize the matrix.

Best,
SoJin Lee
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0173

Attachment: Vivant_MPA_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet; draft milestone matrix)

From: Lydia Park <lpark@vivantlabs.com>

Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@vivantlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:41:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: governance matrix + proposed milestones

Thanks Soojin — nice write-up. A few clarifications and asks from our side:

1) Procurement: Tom is the main procurement contact and will own contract cadence. Please include "expected payment terms" in the next commercial draft (our standard is Net 45; we can discuss).
2) SOC2: we will need a copy of Redwood's SOC2 report and a short description of your logging retention (rolling 90 days vs. archival). Can you attach or link that?
3) Trial scope: We prefer a limited production-similar trial (not isolated sandbox) so we can validate latency under load. Can Redwood provision a small reserved pool for the trial window?

A couple of small edits to milestones: move performance baseline completion to 2027-05-24 (internal testing holidays on 5/21–5/22). Also add a short step for "procurement PO & legal signoff" scheduled 2027-05-30.

If you can update the MPA with these date changes and include a SOC2 artifact or pointer, we can confirm internally next week.

On a related note: Tom — can you confirm your procurement lead's email (or loop them) so we can start the template?

Appreciate it — Lydia
Lydia Park
